title: The Silent Failures in Agentic Data Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.14115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have significantly lowered the barrier to writing code. Naturally, this has also led to the development of data science agents that promise automating the design and execution of data science from task formulation to model development. Existing evaluations of agentic data science (agentic DS) assess downstream predictive performance and code correctness, providing preliminary insight in agentic DS capabilities. We argue that these evaluations overlook the fundamental principles of data science: methodological data science- and domain knowledge. As such, only assessing downstream performance masks methodological failures such as data leakage and inappropriate validation, limiting the development of robust agentic DS systems. translated_title: 智能体数据科学中的静默失败
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型显著降低了编写代码的门槛。这自然也推动了数据科学智能体的发展，这类智能体承诺实现从任务制定到模型开发的数据科学设计与执行全流程自动化。现有的智能体数据科学评估主要考察下游预测性能和代码正确性，为智能体数据科学的能力提供了初步认识。我们认为，这些评估忽视了数据科学的基本原则：方法论层面的数据科学知识与领域知识。因此，仅评估下游性能会掩盖方法论层面的失败，例如数据泄露和不当验证，从而限制了健壮的智能体数据科学系统的发展。在本文中，我们从三个不同角度对智能体数据科学进行了超越准确率的评估：1）对常见智能体数据科学框架和模型在220个数据科学任务中的失败模式进行大规模分析……
tldr: 该论文指出，仅依靠预测准确率和代码正确性来评估数据科学智能体会掩盖数据泄露、不当验证等“静默”的方法论失败，并通过对220个数据科学任务的大规模失败模式分析，提出了超越准确率的三维度评估方法。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that evaluating agentic data science solely by downstream predictive performance and code correctness masks silent methodological failures such as data leakage and inappropriate validation, and presents a large-scale analysis of failure modes across 220 data science tasks to evaluate agentic DS beyond accuracy.
